# phase-052 — Wire the REPL to a real line editor: TAB completion, persistent history, sane interrupts

## You must change `src/`

This phase declares `must_touch: [src/]`. The gate fails the phase unless at
least one changed file falls under it. Writing tests, documentation or a report
is not enough — if you finish without touching that area, the phase fails on
exactly that check.


## Evidence — verified finding

```
src/repl/mod.rs:166 reads every line with `io::stdin().read_line(__FINDING__mut input)` — cooked-mode stdin, so no keystroke ever reaches the program: TAB arrives as a literal tab character, Up-arrow arrives as escape bytes, and Ctrl-C kills the process. `Repl::complete()` at src/repl/mod.rs:112 is a tested completion engine (src/repl/completer.rs, case-insensitive, keywords + builtins + session names) that nothing calls on a keypress — the same dead-code shape as the `builtin_function` defect phase-032 fixed. `src/repl/history.rs` keeps an in-memory `VecDeque` with `save_to_file`/`load_from_file` (history.rs:76) that only the explicit `:save`/`:restore` commands touch (mod.rs:594, mod.rs:623) — no `~/.redblue/history` is ever loaded at startup or written at exit, so every session starts amnesiac. `Cargo.toml` depends on regex, chrono, reqwest and indexmap only: no line-editing crate exists anywhere in the tree. Verified by running the binary: piped input works, interactive keys cannot.
```

**Re-verify this before you change anything.** If the finding no longer
reproduces on `main`, stop and write that to `FINDINGS.md` — a stale phase must
never be "fixed" by inventing a change.

## Goal

Replace the `read_line` loop with a line editor (rustyline) so TAB completes through the existing `ReplCompleter`, Up/Down walks a history file at `~/.redblue/history`, and Ctrl-C abandons the line instead of the session. No language change: the editor is I/O around the unchanged `execute_line` path.

## Definition of done

- [ ] typing `say to_up` + TAB offers `to_uppercase` (and only live names: a `set foo` line makes TAB after `fo` offer `foo`)
- [ ] `Cargo.toml` gains one line-editing dependency and `cargo build --offline` is NOT required to pass — the dep must resolve from crates.io on CI, pinned with a lockfile entry
- [ ] exiting and restarting the REPL preserves history: the acceptance test writes a line, drops the session, builds a new one against the same history file, and asserts the line is offered
- [ ] Ctrl-C on an empty line keeps the session alive and Ctrl-D still exits cleanly with `Goodbye!`, each pinned by a test that drives the editor layer rather than a TTY
- [ ] when stdin is not a TTY (piped input, CI) the session behaves byte-identically to today: the existing `repl_test.rs` suite passes unmodified
- [ ] edge_* tests cover TAB on an empty prefix, TAB with no match (bell, no crash), a history file that does not exist yet, and a history file that is not writable
